description: Declarative URA & Cross-MDA Portal Navigation Knowledge Pack (MOD-GAP-03)

mda_ntr_prn_reconciliation.title: Cross-MDA NTR Payment Registration Number (PRN) Reconciliation & Form DT-3008 Refund
prerequisites: Bank or Mobile Money transaction receipt
steps: Open https://ura.go.ug -> Payment Services -> Search PRN Status and enter your 13-digit PRN.
Confirm whether URA e-Tax shows 'T' (Transacted/Paid), 'A' (Available/Unpaid), 'R' (Received at Bank), or 'X' (Expired).
If status is 'T' (Paid) on URA e-Tax, return to the agency portal (UDLS, DCIC e-Passport, NIRA, MLHUD UgNLIS, URSB OBRS, NEMA, or UNBS) and click 'Verify Payment / Reconcile PRN'.

If paid under the wrong MDA or tax head, log in to https://portal.ura.go.ug -> e-Services -> Refund Application -> Form DT-3008 (NTR Refund) and attach your receipt plus the MDA Non-Utilization Confirmation Letter.

voluntary_disclosure_and_instalments.title: Voluntary Disclosure (Form DT-10307) 100% Penalty Waiver & Section 40 Instalment Plan
prerequisites: Schedule of omitted/unfiled tax periods prior to any URA audit notice
steps: Log in to https://portal.ura.go.ug -> e-Services -> Compliance -> Voluntary Disclosure (Form DT-10307) BEFORE any URA audit notice is served.
Declare the omitted principal tax to receive a 100% statutory waiver of penal tax and late-payment interest under TPC Act s.66(1a).
If paying in instalments under TPC Act s.40, open e-Services -> Debt Management -> Apply for Instalment Payment, generate the 25% down-payment PRN, and unlock your Tax Clearance Certificate (TCC).
